objects.label: Tavern Door
objects.description: Heavy wooden door between tavern and dungeon room. Passable when open (passable=true), not movable (movable=false), connects rooms.

objects.label: Bar Counter A
objects.description: Fixed wooden bar counter segment (left section). Impassable fixture (passable=false, movable=false). Note: blocks_movement and cost_multiplier are schema-required but not currently used by rendering code.

objects.label: Bar Counter B
objects.description: Fixed wooden bar counter segment (middle section). Impassable fixture (passable=false, movable=false). Note: blocks_movement and cost_multiplier are schema-required but not currently used by rendering code.

objects.label: Bar Counter C
objects.description: Fixed wooden bar counter segment (right section). Impassable fixture (passable=false, movable=false). Note: blocks_movement and cost_multiplier are schema-required but not currently used by rendering code.

objects.label: Round Table A
objects.description: Moveable round tavern table (movable=true, passable=false). Can be pushed by players. Currently, rendering uses only passable/movable/stackable flags; cost_multiplier reserved for future pathfinding.

objects.label: Long Table A
objects.description: Moveable long wooden table (movable=true, passable=false). Can be pushed by players. Currently, rendering uses only passable/movable/stackable flags; cost_multiplier reserved for future pathfinding.

objects.label: Stool Stack
objects.description: Stacked stools (movable=true, passable=true, stackable=true). Entities can share hex with this object. Unique combination allows flexible positioning.

objects.label: Crate Stack
objects.description: Supply crates (movable=true, passable=false, stackable=true). Blocks hex occupancy but can be pushed. Higher cost_multiplier for future pathfinding complexity.

objects.label: Stone Fireplace
objects.description: Large stone fireplace (movable=false, passable=false). Provides warmth and light. Fixed environmental decor.

objects.label: Decorative Rug
objects.description: Woven tavern floor rug (movable=false, passable=true). Purely decorative floor element, does not impede movement or hex occupancy.
